verdict.rationale: Docs repeatedly claim LlamaParse produces 'clean markdown/JSON' for LLM pipelines (llamaparse-docs-2, docs-12, docs-25, docs-11) and community feedback confirms strong performance on complex layouts (comm-1, comm-2), but none of the evidence specifically addresses stripping repeated headers/footers or 'page furniture,' and community reports flag remaining noise (tables not returned in clean tabular form, comm-3) and a benchmark dispute where a naive PyPDF pipeline outperformed LlamaParse's reported faithfulness score (comm-6). missing for 10: explicit documentation/testing of header/footer/page-furniture removal, independent benchmark confirming output cleanliness beyond vendor claims.
